python3 - <<'PY'
import json, sqlite3
con=sqlite3.connect('file:/app/main.db?mode=ro', uri=True)
rows=con.execute('SELECT id, name, value FROM inventory ORDER BY id').fetchall()
con.close()
records=[{'id': int(i), 'name': str(n), 'value': int(v)} for i,n,v in rows]
with open('/app/recovered.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(records, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print(f'Wrote {len(records)} verified base-snapshot records.')
PY
cat /app/recovered.json
